cards.card_text: They'll desecrate those idols and throw them away like menstrual cloths, saying to them, "Be gone!" Then the prophet turns to the seed they've sown in the ground.
cards.verse_text: You will throw them away like menstrual cloths, saying to them, “Be gone!” Then He will send rain for the seed that you have sown in the ground, and the food that comes from your land will be rich and plentiful.

cards.card_text: In her, men uncover the nakedness of their fathers and violate women during their menstrual impurity.
cards.verse_text: In you they have uncovered the nakedness of their fathers; in you they violate women during their menstrual impurity.
